meta.name: zx-script
meta.description: Write, refactor, or improve zx-based CLI scripts. Use when creating shell automation with JavaScript/TypeScript, converting bash scripts to zx, or adding error handling and logging to existing zx scripts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 JavaScript 编写、重构或改进命令行脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用 shell 脚本但想用 JS/TS 替代
copy.tagline_en: Write, refactor, or improve CLI scripts using JavaScript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write shell scripts but prefer JavaScript/TypeScript

howto.what: Claude 会帮你编写、重构或改进基于 zx 的 CLI 脚本，支持 JavaScript/TypeScript，自动添加错误处理和日志。
howto.when: 当你要求编写新的 CLI 自动化脚本、将 bash 脚本转换为 zx，或改进现有 zx 脚本的错误处理和日志时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 zx 脚本，批量重命名当前目录下的 .txt 文件。
把这个 bash 脚本改写成 zx 版本，并添加 --dry-run 支持。
say.note: Claude 会转换脚本并增加安全执行选项。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you write, refactor, or improve zx-based CLI scripts using JavaScript/TypeScript, with automatic error handling and logging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write new CLI automation scripts, convert bash scripts to zx, or improve existing zx scripts with better error handling and logging.

say_en.text: Write a zx script to batch rename .txt files in the current directory.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a complete zx script with error handling and logging.

say_en.text: Convert this bash script to zx and add --dry-run support.
say_en.note: Claude will rewrite the script and add a safe execution option.
